name: sdlc-guard
description: Blocks destructive shell commands, redacts secrets from tool results and enforces commit hygiene (no co-author trailers, explicit paths, no local env files).

patterns.title: Extra deny patterns
patterns.description: Comma-separated regexes for Bash commands to deny, e.g. \bkubectl\s+delete\b

localFiles.title: Extra local-only files
localFiles.description: Comma-separated regexes for paths that must not be staged

secretPatterns.title: Extra secret patterns
secretPatterns.description: Comma-separated regexes redacted from tool results

coAuthor.title: Refuse Co-Authored-By trailers
coAuthor.description: Deny git commits whose message carries a Co-Authored-By trailer

blanketStaging.title: Refuse git add -A / git commit -a
blanketStaging.description: Deny git add -A / git add . / git commit -a; stage explicit paths

redactSecrets.title: Redact secrets in tool results
redactSecrets.description: Replace API keys, tokens and private keys in tool results with placeholders
